notes:
Scope: the pinned node's primary color image stream. The package is a configuration-only RosDriver over rosbridge: the relative publisher 'image' at src/astra_driver.cpp:190 is configured as /image (source_name 'image'), with sensor_msgs/msg/Image and ros_version 2. The node's color video mode is PIXEL_FORMAT_RGB888 (src/astra_driver.cpp:153-154); the frame listener maps it to RGB8 with step 3*width (src/astra_frame_listener.cpp:145-147), fills width/height and is_bigendian=0 from the device frame (src/astra_frame_listener.cpp:115-123), and the color callback sets the frame id and publishes (src/astra_driver.cpp:555-559). The stock image artifact path turns one complete packet into a lossless PNG; the flat fixed-subscription profile keeps the legacy image_ref/width/height/media_type output and does not add the ROS source header to the artifact descriptor. No camera geometry, calibration or metadata is inferred. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none; the card's RosDriver helper matches the pinned ROS 2 runtime. The main resource is the documented empty object because this is an observation-only camera and the image is an explicit capture, not an automatic snapshot. The host transport budget is 8 MiB, enough for the default 1280x1024 RGB8 frame (3,932,160 raw bytes, about 5.24 MB base64); the image parser bounds are 4 MiB input bytes and 4 Mi pixels (max_input_bytes > the default 3,932,160-byte frame; max_pixels > 1,310,720 pixels). These are host policy, not source or device limits. NOT COVERED: the depth image on /depth because rawToFloatingPointConversion publishes TYPE_32FC1 (src/astra_driver.cpp:1114-1127) and the fixed ROS image profile refuses float depth; the IR image on /ir_image because the pinned active code never assigns the IR video mode's pixel format, so no encoding citation is possible; /depth_camera_info camera geometry; image controls (resolution, exposure, format) and service calls; compressed republishers; ROS parameters or remapping. The fake is a ROS-free synthesized controlled peer (not a captured recording and not the upstream simulator): it answers only the declared /image subscribe with a complete placeholder 4x2 RGB8 Image, while the real default frame is 1280x1024. A full-resolution lossless PNG can exceed the local artifact store's default 2 MiB per-artifact bound; a deployment may pass a larger explicit LocalArtifactStore bound (up to 16 MiB), and the fake gate does not prove that capacity. The endpoint /image assumes the default root namespace; a namespaced or remapped deployment must expose the capture there, and that graph assumption is not an upstream fact. Gate result: G1-G7 and G9 pass; G8 warns only G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (awarded CL2) because this R0 observation driver has no actuating limit to probe. No ROS graph, camera, hardware or upstream simulator was run; the evidence is fake contract_checked only. The package is model-authored, driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null, and RosDriver refuses every hardware backend without a human hardware review.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the /image binding (relative 'image' created through nh_ = n on the root-namespace node astra_camera, src/astra_driver.cpp:52-54, 190 and ros/astra_camera_node.cpp:131), the RGB8 encoding and step (src/astra_frame_listener.cpp:145-147), the 8 MiB transport and 4 MiB / 4 Mi-pixel image bounds against the 1280x1024 default, all facts, the absence of any service (get_serial is commented out at astra_driver.cpp:235) and the R0 passive scope. Three facts said more than their ranges: the hasColorSensor condition is on line 185, outside 186-191; the depth-conversion fact cited 1114-1127 for a division by 1000 on line 1141 and omitted that 0 and 0x7FF samples become NaN (1135-1137); and 'these are launch defaults, not device bounds' was an inference, now replaced by a fact on the -w, -h and -f option parsing (ros/astra_camera_node.cpp:56-69). Reviewer changed driver.py and facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and the digest unchanged, and all eight tests pass. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Passive color camera at R0; the Astra's IR projector is not driven by this profile. The node publishes with rmw_qos_profile_sensor_data (best effort, astra_driver.cpp:190): a rosbridge subscription that requests reliable QoS receives nothing and the capture fails at its 10 s timeout. The node uses early ROS 2 APIs (set_parameter_if_not_set, astra_camera_node.cpp:134-136) and spins only the node astra_camera (140), so the deployment's ROS 2 distribution must build and run it. A full-resolution PNG can exceed the artifact store's 2 MiB default. The card's licence is NOASSERTION while package.xml declares BSD (package.xml:7).
